reason_definitions.missing_speaker: No speaker name, so the clip cannot be put in a speaker-disjoint split.
reason_definitions.duplicate_id: The same clip ID appears more than once.
reason_definitions.duplicate_audio: The audio bytes are identical to an earlier clip.
reason_definitions.decode_error: ffmpeg could not decode the audio.
reason_definitions.duration_mismatch: Decoded length differs from the metadata length (broken or cut audio).
reason_definitions.duration_out_of_range: Clip is shorter or longer than the allowed range.
reason_definitions.annotation: Transcript contains brackets or symbols that mark editorial notes.
reason_definitions.digits: Transcript contains digits; the spoken form of a number is ambiguous.
reason_definitions.non_latin_script: Transcript contains letters from another script.
reason_definitions.speaking_rate: Characters per second are outside the normal range (likely misalignment).
reason_definitions.alignment_gap: Long untranscribed gap at the start, end, or between words (likely missing words).
